meta.name: lark-workflow-meeting-summary
meta.description: 会议纪要整理工作流：汇总指定时间范围内的会议纪要并生成结构化报告。当用户需要整理会议纪要、生成会议周报、回顾一段时间内的会议内容时使用。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按时间段汇总会议纪要并生成结构化报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常需整理团队会议记录并定期产出摘要
copy.tagline_en: Summarize meeting notes into a structured report for a time range
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to compile meeting notes into reports

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按你给的时间范围搜索飞书会议，逐场取出纪要信息与链接，汇总成结构化报告：单日输出「今日会议概览」，多日输出「会议纪要周报」；你要求时还可生成云文档。
howto.when: 当你提到「整理会议纪要」「生成会议周报」「回顾一段时间内的会议内容」等，或说出「今天」「这周」「上周」这类时间范围时触发。默认按过去 7 天处理。

say.text: 帮我整理这周的会议纪要
say.note: 默认汇总过去 7 天，输出周报

say.text: 把上周的会议纪要生成一份文档

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude searches your Lark meetings for a given time range, collects each meeting's note info and links, and builds a structured report: a daily overview for one day, a weekly digest for several days. It can also create a cloud doc on request.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to organize meeting notes, generate a meeting weekly report, or review meetings over a period, or name a range such as today, this week, or last week. Defaults to the past 7 days.

say_en.text: Help me organize this week's meeting notes
say_en.note: Summarizes the past 7 days as a weekly report

say_en.text: Turn last week's meeting notes into a document
say_en.note: Summarizes then creates a Lark doc
